inlines.v: LOCOMO'TIVE, adjective Moving from place to place; changing place, or able to change place; as a locomotive animal. Most animals are distinguished from plants by their locomotive faculty. Locomotive engine, a steam engine employed in land carriage; chiefly on railways.
